title: How decision-making moved, 6 to 22 November 2026 (a Wardley map story)
audience: Dinis and strategy.d: to see the map move and judge whether this is a good way to tell a map story
summary: A Wardley map of decision-making, played as an animation: each dated event creates or moves a part. This is an experiment in telling map stories as short narrated videos; the map is a reading of the sources, not a measurement.

beats.narration: A Wardley map shows what something is made of, and how mature each part is. Today we watch one move: how decisions get made in Dinis's estate, from 6 to 22 November.
6 November: decisions become pages, with every option shown. The first form of the idea.
